assumptions.choice: Buy size is calculated as 1% of current total broker value divided by the current close price.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires 1% of total trading capital per trade but does not define share rounding or whether commissions are included in the allocation.

assumptions.choice: After a completed buy, a limit sell order is placed at the fixed previous-high level captured on the entry signal.
assumptions.reason: A limit sell is the closest literal implementation of exiting only when price reaches the stated take-profit level.

assumptions.choice: The target is the highest High of the 20 bars immediately preceding the entry-signal bar.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly requires the highest high over the last 20 bars prior to entering.

assumptions.choice: The strategy is applied to the supplied AAPL H1 feed without instrument-universe filtering.
assumptions.reason: The stated major-currency-pair/high-liquidity-index restriction cannot be satisfied because the harness supplies only AAPL data.
